title: Temporary For-Hire Permits on Wayfare Driver Agreements: Desk Guidance and Driver Upload Tool
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing.** A Wayfare driver who has renewed a for-hire permit receives a temporary for-hire permit on renewal (the renewal receipt) and may ask to have it accepted as the for-hire permit on file.

## Rule

The temporary for-hire permit issued on renewal is accepted as the for-hire permit on file for its temporary permit acceptance days, counted in calendar days from the day the driver uploads it. The upload puts the temporary permit on the standing record with an expiry date of the upload day plus the temporary permit acceptance days, and the for-hire permit expiry date on the agreement becomes that same date.

## When the days may be worked out

The temporary permit acceptance days are not worked out until the vehicle inspection expiry date on the agreement carries the validity of the latest inspection uploaded to the standing record.

Before the temporary permit acceptance days are worked out, the agreement must already carry the document hold owed for a vehicle registration whose grace days have run out.

Each of these is a state of the agreement's own records at the time the days are worked out: the vehicle inspection expiry date it shows, and the hold it carries.

## Upload tool

The upload is the driver's own act, made with the customer tool `upload_temporary_permit_14d2792d`. The support agent unlocks the tool and hands it over; the customer themselves (the driver) runs it.

- `driver_agreement_id`: the reference number of the driver's own services agreement, as read out by the support agent from the driver agreement lookup.
- `accepted_days`: the accepted period of the temporary permit, as given by the support agent, as a whole number of calendar days counted from today (integer, no decimals, no unit text). The permit expiry date on file becomes today plus that many days.

One run adds a document upload to the driver's standing record, of document type `commercial_permit` (the for-hire permit), dated today, with an expiry date of today plus `accepted_days` calendar days, and sets the for-hire permit expiry date on the driver services agreement to that same date.

## Receipt

A dictionary receipt with `upload_reference` (the reference number of the new standing record entry), `driver_agreement_id`, `document_type` (`commercial_permit`), `permit_expiry_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, the permit expiry date now on file) and `uploaded_on` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, today's date). A receipt with an `upload_reference` means the temporary permit is on file. The tool's contract defines no other outcome.

Hypothetical illustration: run on 2026-09-05 with `accepted_days` of `17`, the receipt shows a `permit_expiry_date` of `2026-09-22`.
